title: Refund Request
description: Confirm that a customer's refund request has been received and is being reviewed.
subject: Refund Request Received - Booking {{bookingReference}}
body:
Dear {{customerName}},

Thank you for contacting us regarding the refund for your booking {{bookingReference}}.

We have received your refund request and our team is currently reviewing it in accordance with the applicable fare rules and refund policy.

We will notify you once the review is complete. Please note that processing times may vary depending on your payment provider and the applicable refund conditions.

If you have any additional information regarding your request, please reply to this email and include your booking reference.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Kind regards,
Customer Support Team

title: Booking Confirmation
description: Confirm that a customer's booking details have been recorded and provide guidance on checking the itinerary.
subject: Your Booking Confirmation - {{bookingReference}}
body:
Dear {{customerName}},

Thank you for choosing our airline.

We are writing to confirm that your booking reference is {{bookingReference}}.

Please review your itinerary and passenger details to ensure that all information is correct. We recommend checking your flight schedule and applicable baggage allowance before departure.

For a smoother journey, please arrive at the airport with sufficient time to complete check-in and security procedures. Check-in deadlines and boarding requirements may vary by airport and destination.

If you notice any discrepancies in your booking or need assistance, please contact our customer support team and provide your booking reference.

We appreciate your choice and look forward to welcoming you on board.

Kind regards,
Customer Support Team

title: Flight Change Inquiry
description: Respond to a customer asking about changing their flight and explain which details are needed to review available options.
subject: Flight Change Inquiry - Booking {{bookingReference}}
body:
Dear {{customerName}},

Thank you for contacting us about changing your flight associated with booking {{bookingReference}}.

We will be happy to review the available options for your request. Flight changes are subject to seat availability, applicable fare rules, and any change fees or fare differences.

To help us review your request, please provide your preferred new travel date and, if applicable, your preferred departure time or alternative flight.

Please do not consider your itinerary changed until you receive an official confirmation of the updated booking.

If you have already provided your preferred travel details, our team will review the information and advise you on the next steps.

Thank you for your understanding. We look forward to assisting you.

Kind regards,
Customer Support Team
